Figure 1:(a) Gradient Blockage in Discrete Selection. Sparse attention withdiscrete Top-KKselectionprevents gradients propagation from language modeling loss to selector. Existing approaches bypass this issue usingauxiliary distillation[DeepSeek-AI, 2026,Gao et al., 2026]orheuristics[Lu et al., 2025,Zhao et al., 2026].
(b) Differentiable Continuous Gating. SAS keeps discrete Top-KKselection but attaches a continuous soft gate to each selected block, enabling gradient flow from the language modeling loss to the selector.
